execution.implementation: Deterministic extraction of named global geometry and map-model fit observations from the retained current 4V1W wwPDB PDF report

observations: The retained 56-page report was generated on 2026-03-09 using wwPDB Validation Pipeline 2.49, MolProbity 4-5-2 with Phenix2.0, and MapQ 1.9.13.
The report lists clashscore 8, 517 close contacts, 48 bond-length outliers, 298 bond-angle outliers, 24 Ramachandran outliers, and 265 non-rotameric sidechains.
Gly156 is listed as a Ramachandran outlier in every deposited chain A-X.
Whole-model atom inclusion is 0.535 and Q-score is 0.296 at the linked EM map.
interpretation: The public validation observations identify residues and geometry that merit review in the deposited 4.70 angstrom EM model.
limitations: An outlier is a review target and does not by itself prove a residue is modeled incorrectly.
Q-score and atom inclusion are map-model observations, not AlphaFold confidence, PAE, affinity, or energy.
The result describes the retained report snapshot and can change when wwPDB regenerates the report.
rosalind_open did not submit 4V1W or its validation report, assess residue quality, or execute a Rosalind scientific job.

provenance.note: The report hash, generation date, software versions, named counts, map-fit values, and repeated Gly156 observation are retained; the separate genuine Rosalind task-chooser observation states that no Rosalind scientific job ran.

reproduction: Confirm the retained PDF hash and compare every extracted count with the full report.
